limitations.summary: SolidJS 2.0.0-rc.4 removes the solid-js/web export while @tanstack/solid-router 2.0.0-rc.4 declarations still import it. Production stays on the verified Solid 1 line until the public RC packages converge and pass this canary.
TypeScript 7.0.2 is the native project compiler and does not expose the legacy JavaScript programmatic compiler API. No TypeScript 6 alias is currently used.
